newsitem.title: USA: Bollinger sells unit to Rehab Plus.
newsitem.headline: Bollinger sells unit to Rehab Plus.

text.p: Bollinger Industries said it had sold its Bollinger Healthcare division to Rehab Plus of Lubbock, Texas, for $1.6 million.
The company said in a statement that the division produces orthopedic supports and rehabilitation products which are primarily sold through medical distributors.

Bob Bollinger, president of Bollinger Industries, said, "This sale is part of our plan to focus Bollinger Industries on our core fitness business. We found a good fit for our healthcare products and people with Rehab Plus."
